summary: BTC back near $82.8k (+1.4% 24h) after weekend lows near $80k, which traders treat as solid support. Bearish weekly engulfing (Ansem) points to $75k/$72k risk, but on-chain inflows are stabilising (Willy Woo), the US turned net BTC importer, Saylor teased another Strategy buy (not yet filed), and US futures opened higher despite 'Black Monday' chatter. Dominance ~60.8%, a 14-month high. Slightly positive vs last night.
catalyst_note: No BTC-specific dated event; Strategy buy only teased, not filed
